name: wobo-learner
_overrides_why: bun audit reported 17 advisories (16 high, 1 moderate) on 2026-09-04, every one of them a
TRANSITIVE dependency of vite, vite-plugin-pwa or @vitejs/plugin-react. `bun update` fixed
none of them: the vulnerable versions sit inside those packages' own ranges, and
`bun update --latest` is a breaking bump of the whole build. All are build-path rather than
shipped runtime, which is the mitigating fact and not an excuse: two of the fast-uri
advisories are SSRF and the build path is what produces the artefact families download.
These five pins are the smallest thing that closes them. `bun audit` reports No
vulnerabilities found with them in place. Remove each one the day the parent package's own
range moves past it; an override left in place after that is a pin nobody is watching.
